newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM gold ends sharply lower as yen climbs.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM gold ends sharply lower as yen climbs.

text.p: Yen-based gold futures extended early losses to close sharply lower on Thursday, battered by the yen's sharp rise against the dollar, traders said.
Trade was buoyant due to volatility in the currency market, traders said. The dollar fell to a four month low of 115.60 yen in early Tokyo trade.

Gold futures just avoided hitting their daily limit in price fluctuations of 40 yen per gram. Prices ranged from 19 to 38 yen per gram weaker, with benchmark April ending down 38 yen at 1,295 yen. Spot gold was quoted at $347.25/75 per ounce, against $346.80/347.30 in New York on Wednesday.
